tokenization: ids are concatenated. bos, then text token ids truncated to max_prompt_tokens, then the ids of a lone newline, then the ids of the label encoded alone
continuation: label token ids from encoding the label alone, add_special_tokens false
score: mean log-probability of the continuation tokens
dtype_note: Revised 2026-10-08. The first runs stored the trained weights in bfloat16, which rounded most AdamW updates at this learning rate to zero. Those results are kept under artifacts/superseded-bf16/.
extra_seeds_note: Added 2026-10-08 after the seed-20261007 results. Same recipe; the seed sets the head initialisation and the batch order. Results are written under seed-<n>/.
per_dataset_note: Added 2026-10-08. The seed-20261007 Banking77 decoder jobs ran out of memory at batch 8 and trained at the fallback of batch 4 and chunk 4. An extra-seed job then started at batch 8 without failing and ran about four times slower in overflowed GPU memory. Banking77 is pinned to the sizes the seed-20261007 results actually used, so every seed shares one recipe.
